{{Quote|Sir, I am a librarian. I am here to assist you in whichever way you deem felicitous."<br />"Sent by whom?"<br />"Sector Admiral Poteet, sir.|PRC-3 and Atour Riten converse|<ref name="DSn" />}}
'''Poteet''' was a [[Sector admiral/Legends|Sector admiral]] who served in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="DSn" /> In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> he sent the [[Librarian droid/Legends|librarian droid]] [[P-RC3]] to the [[Death Star Library]] for duty, where the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] worked under [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Atour Riten]].<ref name="DSn" />

==Behind the scenes==
Poteet was first mentioned in the [[2007]] novel [[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']] by [[Michael Reaves]] and [[Steve Perry]].<ref name="DSn" />
